info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Talc Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Talc Recliner Details Submission API allows businesses to create detailed entries for Talc recliners within the catalog. This endpoint facilitates the addition of specifications, features, and other relevant details that help consumers make informed purchasing decisions. Typically utilized by product managers and inventory specialists, it streamlines the process of maintaining up-to-date and comprehensive product information. By ensuring rich and accurate descriptions, businesses can enhance user experience and drive sales.

post.summary: Create details for a Talc Recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of detailed information for a Talc Recliner product. It accepts relevant data in the request body to persist the details into the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is required for creating or updating the details of a Talc Recliner. It must include all necessary fields for processing the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning detailed talc recliner information.

CreateCatalogTalcReclinerDetailRequest.title: Talc Recliner Operation Request

talc_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Talc recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Talc recliners being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be processed with priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a Talc recliner.

CreateCatalogTalcReclinerDetailRequest.description: This schema defines the structure for the request body when performing operations on Talc recliners.

status.description: The status of the operation indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that were matched during the operation.

CreateCatalogTalcReclinerDetailResponse_.description: Response schema for the successful POST operation on Talc Recliner details.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource that is returned. This should be set based on the content type of the response.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This can help in understanding the performance of the operation.
